Class HistoricalClimateRasterizer

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.HistoricalClimateRasterizer
public final class HistoricalClimateRasterizer extends Object
High-precision Geophysical and Paleoclimatic Rasterizer for Historical Earth Cartography.

Extracted from HistoricalMapGenerator to satisfy the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP). Synthesizes planetary temperature distributions, annual precipitation patterns, seasonality amplitudes, and biomes across historical and paleolithic epochs (-100,000 BP to present-day).

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    • computeSurfaceTemperature

      public static double computeSurfaceTemperature(double lat, double lon, double elevM, long year)
      Computes the mean annual surface temperature at a given geographic coordinate and elevation.
      Parameters:
      lat - latitude in degrees [-90, +90]
      lon - longitude in degrees [-180, +180]
      elevM - elevation above sea level in meters
      year - historical epoch year (negative for BCE/BP)
      Returns:
      surface temperature in degrees Celsius
